analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly ADX at 47.9 shows a clear trend, but considering short-term rebound potential due to daily RSI entering oversold and MACD showing improvement. However, buying action is withheld due to low volume over five days and continued 5-day low pattern.
analysis.narrative:

· 현재가($149.30) vs SMA5($148.25)/SMA20($172.48)/SMA50($203.65): SMA5 상회, SMA20/50 하회하며 단기 약세, 중장기 추세 하락 확인

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-3.8265→-0.6757): 음수 구간이나 개선 중, 추세 전환 신호 가능성
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치(하단 $125.96 근처): 하단 접근 구간, 밴드폭 53.94%로 변동성 확대 가능성
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($140.85): 피벗 S1($110.76) 대비 높은 수준, 이동평균선 기반 지지
· 스윙 저항선 ($153.13): SMA5 상회했으나 SMA20 하회, 돌파 시 추세 전환 기대
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (Lower High 지속, 5일 저가 $124.50): 약화 신호 지속, 추세 하락 확인
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.73배): 5일 평균 대비 위축, 움직임의 신뢰도 하락
· 현 구간 진단 (하락추세): RSI 과매도 탈출 시도 및 MACD 개선 신호 확인 후 매수 진입 고려, 단 거래량 위축 및 Lower High 패턴 지속으로 관망 유지
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($149.30) vs SMA5($148.25)/SMA20($172.48)/SMA50($203.65): Above SMA5, below SMA20/50, indicating short-term bearishness and confirmed downtrend in medium-term.
· Significantly below SMA100($208.51)/SMA200($202.62), confirming strong bearish momentum in long-term.
· 52-week Position(20.9%) + Attempting to enter recovery phase from 52-week low($124.50).
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (21.1→37.5): Attempting to exit oversold territory, showing signs of directional recovery.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-3.8265→-0.6757): In negative territory but improving, potential for trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (near Lower Band $125.96): Approaching lower band, with 53.94% band width indicating potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support($140.85): Higher than Pivot S1($110.76), based on moving averages.
· Swing Resistance($153.13): Above SMA5 but below SMA20, expecting trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Lower High continues, 5-day low $124.50): Weakening signal persists, confirming downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.73x): Below 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Downtrend): Consider buying after confirming RSI's attempt to exit oversold and MACD improvement, but maintain a wait-and-see approach due to contracted volume and continued Lower High pattern.
